title: Ingest command skeleton with txt and md chunking
description: Add the `ingest` subcommand to memory.py. Implement the CLI surface (argparse with --source, --chunk-size, --overlap, --db flags), the dispatcher that routes by file extension, and the chunking logic for .txt (blank-line paragraph boundaries, sentence splitting for oversized paragraphs) and .md (same as .txt but level-2 ## headings are hard chunk boundaries with the heading carried into the next chunk). Wire each chunk into the existing insert/add path. Print progress summary to stderr. Skip chunks shorter than 10 chars and track the skipped count.
acceptance_criteria: memory.py ingest notes.txt adds rows and prints 'Ingesting notes.txt… N chunks added (M skipped).' to stderr
A .txt file with 3 paragraphs under chunk-size produces 3 rows
Paragraph longer than chunk-size is split at sentence boundaries into multiple chunks
A .md file: ## heading text appears at the start of the chunk following the heading boundary
Chunks shorter than 10 chars are silently skipped; count appears in summary
--source defaults to the file basename when not supplied
